## What's new

**Your name is saved with your Personal Guards account.** The Friends in Voice server now keeps your display name and username next to your ID, so people see a name instead of a number. It's sent when your device signs up and again only when you change your name. It's taken from what Discord already shows, so Friends in Voice asks Discord for nothing extra. A device that has never used Personal Guards sends nothing.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.22.1.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
